_comment: CI-RUNNER baseline for .github/workflows/benchmark.yml's relative regression check. This is NOT the 60fps/reference-hardware target from PLAN.md (the developer's PC with a discrete GPU) -- GitHub Actions runners are different, variable-speed hardware; see tools/benchmark/README.md. This baseline is a SECONDARY, informational comparison only -- benchmark.yml's primary check is the PR's merged tree (the refs/pull/N/merge checkout) against the base branch's own tip, both measured in the same run, which cannot go stale the way this file can. Established as the MEAN of two consecutive, functionally-identical 'Refresh benchmark baseline' workflow runs at https://github.com/Lacaedemon/sparta/actions/runs/37270992713 (mean 26.089ms/p95 29.571ms/max 39.697ms and mean 26.624ms/p95 29.816ms/max 34.605ms) -- ubuntu-latest, res://benchmarks/scenarios/large-battle.json at scale 1.0x, warmup_ticks=60 measure_ticks=300 (the CI-tuned window in benchmark.yml, not BenchmarkRunner's local 120/600 defaults). Averaging two runs rather than trusting a single one is deliberate: back-to-back runs with zero functional code difference can swing ~20% from noisy shared-runner timing alone -- a single-run baseline risks reproducing the false-regression problem this automation exists to prevent. Refreshed automatically by .github/workflows/refresh-benchmark-baseline.yml on a weekly schedule; see that workflow for the refresh mechanics, or run it manually via workflow_dispatch.
